Series XXIII: Pride and Progress / The Right Stuff

Pride and Progress News-highlights: 1. New San Francisco law bans AIDS discrimination and mandatory HTLVIII tests 2. Los Angeles Insurance Professionals for Human Rights hold second meeting 3. Gay Anti-Defamation League protests against New York Post for slander, includes footage 4. Gay community response to Governor Cuomo's ban COMMERCIAL: Orientation '85, funded by The National Gay Task Force 5. Paraguayan government harasses gay Paraguayan publisher COMMERCIAL: "New York Native" with Quentin Crisp 6. human rights Texas Commission condemns employment discrimination against people with AIDS, health cards 7. Greenwich Village establishes two new AIDS residences 8. Interview with David Kopay, discusses coming out COMMERCIAL: NGTF Fund for Human Dignity with "Dear Abby" Abigail Van Buren 9. Sports 10. Healthline: Conversations with GMHC: Dr. Mathilde Krim, Chairperson of American Medical Foundation, discusses AIDS Medical Foundation changes 11. Closing credits
The Right Stuff: 1. Current events/media/culture, includes clips COMMERCIAL: AIDS hotline, New York AIDS Action 2. Sybil Bruncheon COMMERCIAL: The Monster 3. Sybil Bruncheon reads letters
